description: Free. Use it when a wallet is about to buy or sell a graduated pons token on Robinhood Chain and needs the transaction to sign; for a token still on its curve use rhc_curve_card instead. For a GRADUATED pons v2 token on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663) and an amount, returns the UNSIGNED swap transaction to sign (to, data, value, chain id) routed by KyberSwap's aggregator, plus the approval to send first when selling, the minimum output and a deadline. Disclosed fee: the transaction pays a 0.25% (25 bps) integrator fee to loophole tape's wallet 0x25d408eF54e60F3006bD13d5A040d525E2F359c2 inside the swap; every answer states the fee, its receiver, the router (0x6131B5fae19EA4f9D964eAc0408E4408b66337b5) and the expected output with and without the fee. Arguments: token (0x address), wallet (0x address that signs and receives), amount (decimal whole units: ETH for side buy, tokens for side sell), side (buy or sell, default buy), slippage_pct (default 1, at most 5). Refused unpaid and with nothing built when our verdict for the token is avoid, the token has not graduated (a live curve has its own sell path: sell_check on rhc_curve_card), the aggregator has no route, or its quote is older than 30 seconds. Holds no keys, signs and sends nothing. Not advice; the verdict word is not a safety verdict.

amount.description: Decimal whole units, at most 18 decimals: ETH for side buy, tokens for side sell

side.description: buy (spend ETH for the token, default) or sell (sell the token for ETH)

slippage_pct.description: Slippage in percent: default 1, at most 5, at most two decimals

token.description: 0x address of a graduated pons v2 token on Robinhood Chain (42 characters)

wallet.description: 0x address that will sign and receive; put in the calldata as sender and recipient
